meaning:
§ Bezek = "lightning"
the home of Adonibezek, the place where Israel rallied under Saul

elsewhere.note: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.
He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
